title: Reel Relaxing | Benchmark Management Vacation Rental
meta_description: Reel Relaxing is a 4.00 bedroom, 2.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Come to “Reel Relaxing” for a pet friendly beach cottage that sits on a canal front lot in Old Seagrove - just 3 blocks from the beach.Kayak, paddleboard or fish on the canal. This body of water eventually reaches Western Lake in WaterColor and the Grayton Beach State Park.With everything on one level and a screened-in porch overlooking the canal, this home is a great choice for your 30A vacation. The convenient location just 3 blocks from the beach and right next door to Seaside.The screened-in porch at the rear of the house has an assortment of chairs, loungers and rockers for your relaxation. Take some time to grill up a feast on the charcoal grill while you enjoy the sites and sounds of being right on the canal.Living room has plenty of seating surrounding the fireplace and TV with DVD player. Kitchen has a pass-through window to the living area with breakfast bar outfitted with 3 bar stools and the separate dining area has seating for 4. For your convenience and easy packing, there is a washer and dryer in the garage.Sleeping Arrangements:Bedroom 1: King bed, TV and DVD player. Private bathroom with shower.Bedroom 2: Queen bed, TV and access to the screened-in porch.Bedroom 3: 2 twin beds, TV.* Sofa in the living area pulls out into a full-sized bed.Your stay at Reel Relaxing comes with Xplorie’s best activities! one ticket per day, per activity! (over $800 in nightly value) Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!* Pet Friendly: This property is pet friendly! If bringing a dog, please contact Reservations as an additional non-refundable pet fee will be added to your booking. A maximum of 2 dogs is allowed at a maximum of 30 lbs. Please see our rental policies for further details.* Parking for 3 cars (1 in garage; 2 in driveway)A Benchmark welcome bag and initial starter kit of amenities are provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, and 1 liner for each trashcan. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of soap/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom, plus 2 washing machine pods.
